name: GRX Di2 RX825
use_case: Road-biased gravel and all-road 2x12 with a chain stabilizer
positioning: The strongest 2x benchmark for broken roads and gravel: close road-like steps, 36T range and SHADOW RD+ chain control.
architecture: Semi-wireless: wireless levers with front and rear derailleurs wired to an internal BT-DN300 battery.

weight.note: No normalized complete-groupset total is recorded; compare only like-for-like component packages.

battery: Internal BT-DN300 derailleur battery; wireless lever controls.
controls_and_app: E-TUBE PROJECT Cyclist plus full or semi-synchronized shift modes; rear derailleur includes SHADOW RD+ stabilization.
package_summary: Core electronic purchases need two levers, FD, RD, BT-DN300, SD300 wires, charger and hydraulic brakes; crank, cassette, chain, rotors and bottom bracket may be separate.

compatibility.frame: Internal BT-DN300 space, FD mount and two SD300 wire routes

china_price_status: No attributable exact mainland package price captured in this batch.
caveats: This is 2x only; do not merge its battery, cassette or derailleur facts with RX717/RX827 1x.
Confirm whether the chosen crank is 46/30 or 48/31 and whether the cassette is 11-34 or 11-36.
